messages:
Sophia Nguyen: :wave: Day 3 check-in — quick status. What I did: completed local dev env (macbook M2), ran the quickstart app, and followed the internal SDK tutorial. Pulled models from the staging registry.

Sophia Nguyen: Blockers: 1) I can't access the 'redwood-infra-staging' GCP project (permission denied). 2) When I run the server locally with GPU flags I hit an error in the docker build step: `ERROR: failed to solve: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to extract image` — suspect registry auth.

Alex Kim: Nice progress! For the GCP access, I can request the role for you. @Devon (IT) can you grant `roles/viewer` and `roles/storage.objectViewer` on redwood-infra-staging to sophia.nguyen@redwood.com?

Devon (IT): On it. I need the exact email. Is sophia.nguyen@redwood.com correct?

Sophia Nguyen: yes that's correct — thanks. Also re: docker error, I tried `docker build . --progress=plain` and saw a 401 when pulling `gcr.io/redwood-docker/base:gpu`.

Alex Kim: That 401 is definitely registry auth. We have short-lived tokens via gcloud auth; try `gcloud auth configure-docker` then re-run. If it still fails, it's likely your SSO not joined to the `registry-access` group.

Sophia Nguyen: I ran `gcloud auth configure-docker` and got a different error: `gcloud: ERROR: You do not have an active account.` I think SSO didn't finish during onboarding.

Priya Desai: Hi Sophia — I just checked your onboarding checklist, the SSO invite was sent to your personal email but you needed to accept using the company invite link. I resent it to your work email. Can you confirm you received the link?

Sophia Nguyen: I see the invite now. Accepting it. After accepting, do I need to wait for a group assignment or is that automatic?

Priya Desai: Group assignment is separate. I'll ping IT to add you to `engineers` and `registry-access`.

Devon (IT): Added a ticket to the queue and assigned to myself — should be done in ~15–30 mins. I'll post here when changed.

Infra Bot: Deploy-bot: note: staging cluster maintenance scheduled 20:00 UTC tonight. Not blocking local dev but heads up for any staging runs.

Alex Kim: For today's goals: once access is fixed, try `make dev-start` and run `pytest tests/unit -k model_loading`. If the tests fail, paste the small failing log here (no full traces). If you still hit the image 401 after SSO + group add, ping me and I'll generate a temporary service account key for you to pull.

Sophia Nguyen: Thanks — plan for today: accept SSO invite, confirm access to GCP and registry, retry docker build, run the unit tests, and start a small PR with a README update documenting the local GPU flags.

Alex Kim: Perfect. Ping me when you're unblocked and we'll schedule a 15-min pairing session if needed. :thumbsup:

Devon (IT): GCP roles applied to sophia.nguyen@redwood.com. Try again and let me know.

Sophia Nguyen: Tried `gcloud auth login` and `gcloud auth configure-docker` — docker pull succeeded. Re-running `make dev-start`. Will report back with tests. :raised_hands:
